Because the harbor ledger tracks the vesting curve, the cipher audit publishes how much each key actually received. Rewards vest linearly over 12 epochs and stop vesting the moment the identity is slashed, so an operator that gets caught forfeits the unvested remainder rather than just the current payment. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
